dining.name: Mango Joe's
dining.summary: The waterfront's island grill — the park's best counter food with lagoon-side seating.
description: Mango Joe's anchors the waterfront food row with Caribbean-leaning grill food: chicken, island-rice plates and the tropical drinks the theming promises. The patio faces the water; the indoor seating is the storm-hour refuge.
It is the park's default lunch — the location, the menu breadth and the climate control all point the same way.
tips: Claim the patio before the noon wave.
The freeze drinks are the queue-friendly dessert-and-hydration combo.
dining.verdict: The best counter meal at the park in the best lunch location. The island chicken plate is the order.

dining.name: Waterfront Cookhouse
dining.summary: The lagoon-edge cookhouse — hearty plates with splash-zone patio seating beside the flume.
description: The cookhouse on the lagoon edge serves the hearty tier — plates, sandwiches and the shaded patio that doubles as Journey to Atlantis splash viewing. The accidental dinner theater is a park tradition.
The menu overlaps Mango Joe's; the seating is the differentiator — flume-front tables for the soak show.
tips: The splash-view tables are the play at lunch.
App ordering beats the register queue at the noon peak.
dining.verdict: Good plates with a free show. Split your lunches between the waterfront and here; both earn it.
